_about: The single source of the five function pages (platform/model/functions/<id>.html). Rendered by _functions.py (--apply); --check refuses a malformed template or a hand-edited page. One template for all five (founder, 2026-09-30: a standardised template per function, a blueprint with its own data in the engine format, enforced at code level; v1 of each function is one AI agent with .md files inside the box covering, S-28). Every function carries the same fields: goal, done, hears, writes, checks, envelope, settings, files (the .md files v1 reads), recipe (its steps as boxes), journeys (its own, each naming the meta journey step it serves). A field the founder has not ruled holds the word placeholder.

functions.name: Identity
functions.lead: Identity is the department's voice and its conscience. It hears what a person says (or what Sutra hands over), decides whether the department has enough to work, files the Brief, keeps the rules, and holds the gates that stop anything from leaving the record without the person's word.

functions.name: Adaptation
functions.lead: Identity holds what the department is for and what it may not do. Adaptation decides how the department gets there, and keeps changing how as it learns. It senses, decides, and acts through four hands: it makes workflows, crystallizes steps from AI to code, grows the department out, and learns what worked into the workflow steps. It keeps going until the goal is reached. Every workflow it makes or changes goes through Root's standards.

Learn: from an ask to its kind. When feedback arrives as a task, find the kind it is one instance of (a component, a stage, a journey, or something else not on the map yet: the kind is found, not picked from a list) and the process that would have caught it; design the whole component, not the one fix. Founder, 2026-10-01: “It doesn't need to be a life cycle, process, or journey. It can be something else. You need to figure that out.” ““whenever some feedback comes out, we find it as a task. We need to figure out what process would have identified that... what the abstraction layer is for which it's just a component. Maybe it's a reflexive action, and then we design the entire component out of it.”
founder, 2026-10-01; placed on the map (platform/structure.html, How an idea is handled)
later; placeholder: the steps of Learn needs to be filled
functions.v1: shape the line from the words, as built for the organic kind: two to five workflows, one AI instruction each, born without a stamp. No loop, no Make module, no compass, no Learn, no Grow, no Crystallize: all later.

functions.name: Priority
functions.lead: Priority holds the money. Every workflow has an envelope, calls and money a day; Priority counts what is spent and holds one that is over. When Adaptation offers a new workflow it prices it and says yes or no. The tie between two ready workflows is Coordination's (S-05).

functions.name: Coordination
functions.kicker: one run at a time, who goes first
functions.lead: Coordination is the timetable. One run at a time; the table says who goes first; a chain from one ask stops at twelve; a run past its window raises an alarm; a request nobody answered inside its bound is closed and said back. It judges nothing about content.
